But we don't have internal code. 4. Invalid JSON string, InputFormat.JSON, validate true => expect exception (JsonProcessingException) or ValidationResult with errors.

5. Null input string => expect NullPointerException or validation error.

6. Unsupported InputFormat (if enum only has JSON/YAML, maybe passing null) => expect NullPointerException.
